title: CompTIA Server+
summary: CompTIA Server+ is a vendor certification offered by CompTIA. This independent study guide covers all 4 objective domains: Server hardware installation and management, Server administration, Security and disaster recovery, Troubleshooting. Each domain is broken into 20 lessons in total, and every lesson has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam. The exams use realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each objective the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: CompTIA certification content is an independent study guide written for CyberPulseAcademy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CompTIA.
